summary: xAI announced that Grok 4.6, its flagship model with a 500k-token context window and configurable reasoning efforts, is now generally available to developers through Amazon Bedrock at stated per-token pricing.

mechanisms.reason: The model is stated to offer a 500k-token context window, a serving property that raises per-system memory content, though this is a restatement of an already-existing model spec rather than a new capability.
mechanisms.quote: It offers 500k context window and configurable reasoning efforts (low, medium, high, xhigh).

categories.reason: The announcement is specifically about Grok 4.6 being distributed through Amazon Bedrock, making the platform relationship itself the subject of the release.
categories.quote: Today, we’re excited to announce that Grok 4.6 is now generally available on Amazon Bedrock.

practices.reason: Teams already using Grok 4.6 elsewhere would need to note the new region and platform availability if they want to integrate via Bedrock instead of the native API.
practices.quote: Grok 4.6 is now available to all developers in supported AWS Regions.
